label: Landscaping
_comment: Landscape design, installation and hardscape firms, not mowing crews. The shared list denies landscap, lawn, irrigation and sprinkler (and 'landscaper' as a primary) so no OTHER trade collects these firms; this is the trade that IS them, so it escapes exactly those. Real landscapers also carry 'Lawn care service' and 'Snow removal service' as SECONDARY categories and in their names ('Green Acres Lawn Care & Landscaping'), so those two leave recurring_deny here and move to primary_deny instead: a firm Google files FIRST as lawn care or snow removal is still a recurring-service crew and is still refused. Lawn mowing stays a hard drop anywhere. Tree service, arborist, nursery, garden center, fence, concrete and paving all stay denied, and the retail words keep a landscape supply yard out.
